supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s find fractions at the same location.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Identify and generate equivalent fractions. Understand two fractions as equivalent if they are at the same point on a number line.
teachingSteps: Identify the whole and divide it into equal parts.
Represent the fraction with a number line or equal-area drawing.
Explain the unit fractions, position, equality or comparison.
